new.title: Deploying the API
new.body: Deploy the API with `make deploy-prod`; it runs the migrations first. No other team depends on this directly, but several people on the project do refer to it from time to time.

old.title: API production deploy
old.body: To put the API in production run make deploy-prod, which applies migrations before starting the service. It is kept short on purpose; the longer discussion happened in chat and was not saved anywhere else.

new.title: HostLinkReconnect backoff
new.body: `HostLinkReconnect` retries with exponential backoff capped at 30 s. Other services do not call this directly, though a few people on the team look it up now and then.

old.title: Reconnect policy
old.body: HostLinkReconnect uses exponential backoff, at most 30 seconds between retries. It was saved while the context was still fresh because the reasoning is hard to reconstruct later.

new.title: Staging DB port
new.body: The staging Postgres moved to port 5433 (it was 5432) on 2026-10-10. It is kept short on purpose; the longer discussion happened in chat and was not saved anywhere else.

old.title: Staging DB port
old.body: Staging Postgres listens on port 5432. It comes from the team's own working notes and has not been reviewed by anyone outside the project. This was written down after the weekly engineering sync so that nobody has to ask the same question twice.

new.title: ภาษาที่ใช้ตอบ
new.body: ผู้ใช้ต้องการให้ตอบเป็นภาษาอังกฤษเสมอ บันทึกไว้หลังประชุมทีมประจำสัปดาห์ เพื่อไม่ต้องถามซ้ำกันอีกในภายหลัง ใครที่เข้ามาดูแลส่วนนี้ต่อควรอ่านก่อนแก้โค้ดหรือค่าตั้งค่าที่เกี่ยวข้อง

old.title: ภาษาที่ใช้ตอบ

new.title: writer_lease during mining
